subject: chemistry
content: One mole of nitrogen gas at 0.8 atm takes 38 s to diffuse through a pinhole. whereas one mole of an unknown compound of xenon with flourine at 1.6 atm takes 57 s to diffuse through the same hole. Calculate the molecular formula of the compound.
